passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: You should read the following discussion of our operating and financial review and prospects together with our consolidated financial statements included in Item 18 in this annual report. Our consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with IFRS, as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (“IASB”). IFRS includes IAS and related interpretations of the committees (SIC and IFRIC). The following discussion and analysis contain forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of factors, including, but not limited to, those under Item 3. D “Risk Factors” and elsewhere in this annual report. A. Operating Results Overview Takeda is a global R&D-driven biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and delivering life-transforming treatments in our core therapeutic areas of gastrointestinal and inflammation, neuroscience and oncology, as well as through our plasma-derived therapies and vaccines business. We have grown both organically and through acquisitions, completing a series of major transactions that have resulted in growth in our areas of therapeutic, geographic and pipeline focus. For more information on the history and development of our company, please refer to “Item 4.A. History and Development of the Company”. Our business is organized as a single operating segment, reflecting the presentation of information to our management for the purposes of allocating resources, measuring performance and forecasting future periods. For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, our revenue and operating profit were JPY 4,505.7 billion and JPY 6.2 billion, respectively. Operating Environment Over the past several years, we have extended our global reach, strengthened our presence in Oncology, GI and Neuroscience, and established a leading position in Rare Diseases and PDT, while adding significant assets to our growing R&D pipeline. Commercially, we have significantly strengthened our presence in the United States, Europe, and other key markets, such as China. We have also accelerated our focus on data, digital and technology to make our business operations more effective and efficient, leading to greater innovation and better serving our stakeholders. Factors Affecting Our Results of Operations Our results are affected by global industry trends and our operating environment as described in “Item 3.D. Risk Factors” and “Item 4. Information on the Company” of this annual report and other factors described below. Patent Protection and Generic Competition For pharmaceutical products, in particular, patent protection and/or regulatory exclusivity benefit our results of operations by restricting competition. Newly introduced products, particularly those which treat conditions for which alternative treatments may not be readily available, may significantly contribute to sales. However, even protected products must compete with products of other manufacturers based on efficacy, lack of adverse reactions and price. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure and shareholder distributions combined, leaving a substantial internal funding surplus after reinvestment and returns. This headroom supports the issuer's ability to deleverage organically without relying on asset sales or new borrowings.

Interest coverage improved year on year, reflecting recovering operating profit against a stable gross interest burden. The upward trajectory in coverage, alongside a rising operating margin, signals that earnings are rebuilding after the prior-year trough and that debt service headroom is widening.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage sits above the sector median on a like-for-like definition, and net leverage is roughly double the sector median, placing the issuer among the more indebted names in its peer group. The indicative financial risk profile is therefore assessed as significant rather than moderate.

The issuer's revenue base depends on patent protection and regulatory exclusivity, and the disclosed risk discussion flags loss or expiration of patent protection as a factor that erodes results as generic competition enters. This creates revenue cliff exposure that could compress the cash flow supporting the debt stack.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains below the sector median despite the year-on-year improvement, and EBITDA coverage is also below peer median. Debt service is met, but the cushion against a profit setback is thinner than for higher-rated pharmaceutical peers with similar business mix.

Cash flow to debt improved year on year yet remains below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is likewise below peers. The issuer relies on sustained operating cash generation, which is sensitive to generic erosion and pipeline execution, to keep servicing obligations comfortably.

overall_credit_view.text: Leverage is trending down year on year and sits just inside the next risk-band boundary, so a modest EBITDA decline or incremental borrowing would push the profile into a weaker tier. Deleveraging progress is the key swing factor for the credit view.

Liquidity is adequate but tight: the current ratio is marginally above unity and well below the sector median, leaving limited working capital buffer. Combined with above-median leverage, this supports a cautious, stable-to-negative analyst judgement pending evidence of sustained cash generation.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以舒適地覆蓋資本開支與股東分派之總和，於再投資及回報後仍留下可觀的內部資金盈餘。此緩衝支持發行人以自身能力去槓桿，而無需依賴資產出售或新增借貸。
利息覆蓋率按年改善，反映經營溢利在穩定之總利息負擔下回升。覆蓋率之上升軌跡，連同經營利潤率上升，顯示盈利正於去年低谷後重建，而償債緩衝正在擴大。

key_risks.text: 按同類可比定義，總槓桿高於行業中位數，而淨槓桿約為行業中位數之兩倍，使發行人處於同業組別中負債較重之列。因此，指示性財務風險狀況被評為顯著而非中等。
發行人之收入基礎依賴專利保護及監管專營權，而所披露之風險討論將專利保護之喪失或屆滿列為隨著仿製藥競爭進入而侵蝕業績之因素。此形成收入斷崖風險，可能壓縮支持債務結構之現金流。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 儘管按年改善，利息覆蓋率仍低於行業中位數，而 EBITDA 覆蓋率亦低於同業中位數。償債得以履行，但相對於業務組合相近而評級較高之製藥同業，抵禦盈利挫折之緩衝較薄。
現金流對債務比率按年改善，但仍低於行業中位數，而自由現金流對債務比率亦低於同業。發行人依賴持續之營運現金產生以舒適地維持償債義務，而該現金產生對仿製藥侵蝕及研發管道執行敏感。

overall_credit_view.text: 槓桿按年呈下降趨勢，且僅處於下一個風險區間邊界之內，因此 EBITDA 輕微下降或新增借貸將把狀況推入較弱層級。去槓桿進展是信貸觀點之關鍵搖擺因素。
流動性充足但偏緊：流動比率僅略高於一，且遠低於行業中位數，留下有限之營運資金緩衝。結合高於中位數之槓桿，此支持謹慎、穩定至負面之分析判斷，直至有持續現金產生之證據。
